notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
A few announcements as I get closer to setting Solaro's launch date...

Last month Solaro got QA testing from Lollipop Robot team in Spain! QA (Quality Assurance) is the last stage of playtesting that improves the overall quality of the gameplay and robustness of the software.
Lollipop did a really great job and helped identify some areas for improvement in Solaro's challenge level and learning curve. A few bugs were also uncovered- but nothing too bad!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43254391/bbd20cc31e410bd7c512585c3f19b5045ff5cfca.png[/img]


Lots of progress has been made putting the final touches on Solaro's graphic images on Steam, as well as on the soundtrack mixing and mastering.


This week I will release an update to Solaro's demo on Steam! v1.0.1 will fix a number of minor bugs in the demo, and contain the latest visuals, music, and sounds! Stay tuned...


Thanks to everyone who has checked out my site and supported me in my [url=https://www.3bodygames.studio/category/all-products]shop[/url] and [url=https://www.3bodygames.studio/donate]donations page[/url]! Your support means a lot, and will help me cover the expenses of Solaro's upcoming launch.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43254391/4b782833cf86967324c9b09d9db3a862881d8d6b.png[/img]


More news on the way!

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Hi - just a quick progress update on Solaro...

Since the beta testing started in the summer, I've been focusing on improving the games user experience and learning curve. Too many player still had trouble with the some of the main mechanics.

I've gotten a lot of feedback and it has been super helpful- just want to say thanks! And please keep it coming. The improvements I have made would absolutely not be possible without your comments and videos...

Also have done a lot of polishing on the visuals, sound and music. Please check out the newest version of the demo/playtest if you get a chance!

I had to delay the launch into early 2025... Sorry. It will be worth it. Stay tuned for more details on that.

I am going to try to post updates more regularly as I get closer to launch, there will be lots of news on the way. To stay up to date please join my mailing list at: www.3bodygames.studio


Player feedback: www.3bodygames.studio/feedback

Other: www.3bodygames.studio/contact

Will also try to start using social media a bit more, so please follow along there too.

Thanks again!! More on the way. Stay tuned

notes.title: July Update
notes.content:
I have finished working on a round of revisions to the game based on feedback from the Next Fest demo.

I launched the demo at Next Fest in February, and it was interesting to get player's reactions...

Some things I tried were a bit experimental, some things worked and others not so much...


Players wanted to see tutorials. My vision for this game was very minimal with less hints/tutorials than a normal game. After looking at the Next Fest results, I realized the game needed at least some tutorials at the beginning to get players started. I restructured the first section of the game, adding dialogue, hints, tutorials and other accessibility-related features. I think the end result keeps the atmosphere mysterious while making the game much more accessible at the same time... Let me know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43254391/225b424d75f9daa8359c03fdd2e8ea12e155227a.png[/img]


Some players did not like the intro. I rewrote it somewhat to help push the story forward a bit better, and also shortened it and made it skippable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43254391/0ff512693e010bf952734493541a0fd7b318a3fc.png[/img]


I made a ton of other updates that I can't list here, but they include modifications of the gameplay mechanics, design improvements, polishing work on music and sound, faster and smoother level transitions, etc.


If you shared feedback, thank you! I really appreciate your thoughts and ideas, and they have helped make the game funner and more accessible. I know I am really slow to respond, but I do read your comments and take your recommendations seriously.

Please keep sharing... on Steam, my site, or Discord :)

notes.title: Responding to your feedback
notes.content:
Solaro's playtesters on Steam have helped us understand the player experience better, and consider possible improvements...

If you shared feedback through the online form, thank you! We're taking your ideas seriously, and have started testing some new features in response.

You can try 2 of these features in the latest playtest update:

1. A couple players commented on timing while moving in space. Sometimes it's hard to choose the right path in the narrow time window, so it would be good to have the option to slow things down temporarily.

When you're moving in space, you can now click and hold down to slow the flow of time. You can then drag to choose between different paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43254391/96f97c5d537a17c0b7c5ca80d7b5bb29646dfe94.png[/img]

2. Players also noted how there are long waiting periods sometimes when moving around the solar system. These can get a bit boring.

To cut down on this a little, we added a feature called Hibernation. If you run out of energy and fall asleep, and you're waiting to be revived, you now have the chance to accelerate time. Enter the zoomed-out/overview mode, and you'll see a button on the bottom right with a fast-forward symbol. For now this will be available during sleep only (ie all your energy is used up). If you want to try and use it strategically, beware that while asleep you're at a risk for hitting asteroids.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43254391/c587fcb9e27b21e475d1bc4b9c21daf895d577ca.png[/img]

What do you think of these features? Did they make things better for you? Comment below, share feedback on our online form: https://3bodygames.studio/playtest , or join the Discord: https://discord.gg/3VDmzyCDPz

notes.title: Playtest Demo is Live
notes.content:
Solaro's first playtest is now available to everyone. Try out the game's unique mechanics, and help the developer by giving your feedback. 

The playtest demo lets you explore the first few planets in the game, and take a peek at all of the different solar systems.

Once you request access it might take us a few days to accommodate you- thanks for your patience. When you're finished, please go to https://3bodygames.studio/playtest , where you have the options to:
[list]
[*] Offer feedback on your gameplay experience
[*] Get your name included in Solaro's credits
[*] Register to playtest the full game (date TBA)
[*] Join our mailing list
[/list]
We're excited to hear your thoughts on Solaro's unique gameplay mechanics. We're especially interested in what you think about:
[list]
[*] The controls? Were they easy to understand and did they feel natural? Mention if you were using a mouse or a trackpad.

[*] Accessibility. Were there options/settings left out that would have improved the experience for you?

[*] The learning curve. If you got stuck somewhere, or confused about the gameplay, tell us about it.

[*] Anything else you want to comment on!
[/list]
The playtest automatically gathers error reports that might come up while you're playing. If you want to report directly on a problem you experienced, for example problems with graphics or audio, be sure to include any info you have about your operating system, graphics card, and other hardware.

If you enjoy game, please consider making a post about it, sharing a link, etc. As we have just a tiny marketing budget, we really rely on word of mouth. Your support makes a difference- Thank you!
